budget.只有你能授权预算。Agent 可在额度内购买、开停机和续费；释放仍由你确认。: Only you can authorize the allowance. Agents can buy, start, stop, and renew within it; releasing a server still requires your confirmation.
budget.按量和抢占式按每月最多 744 小时预留，包含固定 1 Mbps 带宽。停机仍保: Hourly and preemptible servers reserve up to 744 hours each month including fixed 1 Mbps bandwidth. Stopped disks retain their reservation; monthly terms reserve the full price upfront. Disabling authorization prevents new purchases and renewals; existing commitments remain.
budget.授权 Agent 使用服务器预算: Authorize agents to use this server allowance
budget.按预算购买服务器: Buy a server within the allowance
budget.请填写有效的预算金额和服务器数量: Enter valid budget amounts and server counts
budget.固定 1 Mbps 带宽，磁盘和带宽已计入报价。: Fixed 1 Mbps bandwidth; the quote includes the disk and bandwidth.
budget.抢占式服务器可能被阿里云回收，请及时保存工作。: Aliyun may reclaim preemptible servers. Save your work regularly.
budget.剩余额度不足，请先调整预算。: Not enough allowance. Adjust your budget first.
budget.此计费方式暂无可用报价: No quote is available for this billing plan
budget.购买结果需要核对，预算保留，请勿重复购买: The purchase needs reconciliation. Its allowance is retained; do not place another order.
budget.Agent 已停机，磁盘仍保留: Agent stopped the server; disks retained
budget.时价超过授权，已停机: Server stopped because its hourly price exceeds the allowance
budget.余额不足，服务器已停机: Server stopped because the balance is insufficient

browser.授权后，网页内容会发送给服务器和模型。: After approval, page content is sent to the server and model.
